I had almost resigned myself to the idea that this was just my "forever."
​Deep down, I knew that staying on these medications long-term wasn't the right path for me, which sparked my decision to pursue alternative medicine.

After a friend referred me to 'the other song' clinic, I began researching the doctors' profiles. I was immediately intrigued by Dr. Sudhir Baldota and his extensive experience in treating cases similar to mine. I booked an appointment right away and was able to see him within a week. During that first discussion, he spent a dedicated 3 to 4 hours asking about every minute detail of my history.

​I had full faith that I would eventually get better under his care, though the journey itself hasn’t been easy. While I continue with homeopathic medication, I have now been completely off allopathic medicine for nearly four months. Throughout this transition, Dr. Baldota has been incredibly supportive, always available via message or call to offer clarifications or, most importantly, to listen to me work through my trigger points. His unwavering confidence in this treatment and his approachable nature have been the pillars of my recovery. For the first time in over a decade, I feel a sense of balance and hope that I thought was lost.
